scenes.description: Levi Ramirez, a 29-year-old Social Media Planner, meets with his two close friends, Yuna and Han, to discuss his dilemma of choosing between Tribe and Friendster. The three are seated in a quiet corner of the shop, sipping coffee and engaging in a thoughtful conversation.

characters.name: Levi Ramirez
characters.description: Urban white-collar professional, 29 years old. Levi is analytical and thoughtful, often contemplating the deeper implications of his decisions. He works in social media and is deeply invested in how digital platforms shape identity and connection.; Male / Urban White-collar, 29 years old; Occupation: Social Media Planner; Personality: Analytical, Curious, Thoughtful; Values: Authenticity, Flexibility, Connection; Interests: Social media trends, Digital tools, Social networks; Experiences: Active online presence, Collaborative discussion, Platform comparison
characters.position: Seated at the table, looking between Yuna and Han

characters.name: Yuna Chen
characters.description: Yuna Chen; Female; Age: 27; Occupation: Digital Marketing Consultant; Personality: Supportive, opinionated, concerned; Values: Loyalty, nostalgia, authenticity; Interests: Social media trends, indie music, vintage fashion; Experiences: Managed a successful rebrand for a retro tech startup, helped close friends navigate major career transitions, has been using Friendster since college and cherishes its role in her personal history.

characters.name: Han Kim
characters.description: A 30-year-old tech startup founder; Male; Age: 30; Occupation: Co-founder of a social platform startup focused on community-driven networking; Personality: Confident, encouraging, forward-thinking; Values: Innovation, autonomy, collaboration; Interests: Emerging social media trends, urban hiking, startup networking events; Experiences: Successfully scaled a previous app from zero to a million users, struggled with early-stage investor pressure, led a team through a major platform pivot.
characters.position: Levi's right, relaxed in his chair

actions.action: Levi clears his throat and begins the conversation.
actions.dialogue: So, I’ve been thinking a lot about switching to Tribe, but I’m really torn. Friendster has so many people I’ve known for years. What do you guys think?

actions.action: Yuna leans in and responds with concern.
actions.dialogue: Levi, I get it. Tribe is cool and all, but Friendster is where your real connections are. If you leave, you might lose touch with people who’ve been part of your life for a long time.

actions.action: Han sips his coffee and counters with a calm tone.
actions.dialogue: I see where Yuna’s coming from, but I think Tribe offers something more. You can build your own circles, curate your interactions, and actually control your digital identity. That’s kind of the point, right?

actions.action: Levi nods slowly, deep in thought.
actions.dialogue: That’s what I’m curious about. I want to be more authentic online, not just default into the same old groups and tags. But I also don’t want to lose the history I have with some of these people.

actions.action: Yuna gestures gently and adds a personal touch.
actions.dialogue: I remember how we all met online. It was on Friendster. That kind of history is hard to replace. Maybe you can stay on both for a while?

actions.action: Han smiles and leans back, offering a solution.
actions.dialogue: That’s a good idea. But I’d suggest focusing on Tribe for your professional and personal branding. Friendster can still be there for nostalgia, but it might not serve your goals moving forward.

actions.action: Levi takes a sip of his coffee and smiles thoughtfully.
actions.dialogue: Thanks, both of you. I’ll take that into account. It’s not just about the platform, it’s about how I want to show up online—and maybe even offline.

scenes.plot: Levi is at a crossroads in deciding which social media platform to focus on. His friends, Yuna and Han, represent opposing views: Yuna advocates for preserving old connections on Friendster, while Han promotes Tribe for its flexibility and control over one's digital identity. Levi is caught between these two perspectives, trying to align his choice with his values of authenticity and connection while considering the real-life impact of his decision.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the tension between maintaining long-term relationships and pursuing more personalized digital interactions, while showcasing Levi’s personality traits and values through a realistic, public conversation with close friends.
